## Method
- Shortlist: tier1 rows from catalog per stock, robust-filtered (alpha>0 in both validation `2024-08-01..2025-12-31` and test `2026-01-01..2026-09-21`, trades>=5), ranked by min(val,test) alpha, de-duplicated by near-identical rule (indicator-signature Jaccard>=0.6, keep best), capped at 5 per stock.
- Refine: per distinct strategy (grouped over its shortlisted stocks/timeframes), parameters were generated from the strategy's own DSL literals (period-level and threshold-level slots) and tuned with optuna (40 trials) on a **strict train window ending 2024-07-31** only.
- Validation: each (strategy, stock, timeframe) pair re-masked over train / 2024-08-01..2025-12-31 / 2026-01-01..2026-09-21 at base costs (20/5 bps) and stressed costs (40/10 bps).
- **Survivor rule:** alpha>0 in **both** OOS windows at **stressed** costs with trades>=5 in each; no refitting to force a keeper.

## Caveats
- The 222-ticker universe is the **current** membership; historical breadth claims inherit survivorship bias.
- alpha measures after-cost engine return minus **cost-free** buy&hold in the same window; it is an excess-return estimate, not a guarantee.
- Params were optimized on data ending 2024-07-31; validation and test windows were never seen by the optimizer. Small-test-sample stocks (recent IPOs) have thinner windows.
- Historical backtests do not predict future profits; treat picks as research hypotheses to paper-trade/watch.
